methods: dense cosine on original Day 6 pgvector B

improvement_hypotheses.H1: return_k 6 and 4800 chars to reduce missing conditions/context eviction
improvement_hypotheses.H2: candidate_k 20 per branch and at most 4 searches to seek additional evidence

config_change_policy: Only dev may inform new versioned configs. Record hypothesis and results for at least two improvements.
hit_definition: exact source_id + physical page + entire alternative evidence quote within a chunk
context_metric: enough alternative evidence in final model context; semantic review also recorded
runtime_gold_policy: only question and explicit filters; expected_answer/gold/answerable/absence_reason stay in evaluator
filters: none by default; only explicit input chapter/language if configured equally across methods
query_policy: original question ranking reported separately from model-generated query/step rankings
selection_eligibility: all dev cases complete without system error and all required source reviews supplied
unknown_cost_policy: do not impute zero; omit cost tie-break if any eligible config has unknown cost
test_gate: freeze runtime/config/prompt/index/benchmark after dev before any test run
test_review: review every test case for baseline and selected config; context grade on all 5 answerable cases; review each citation
base_system_errors: report separately from answer quality, retain every failed case and completion denominator
authorship_limitation: Questions and implementation authored with the same Codex assistant. Test not executed or used to tune before selection; not a blind authorship study.
manual_review_policy: Read source; record reviewer type. Never turn valid IDs or AI suggestions into alleged human audit.
